description: Read exact unreduced observations of one metric with decimal strings, original source clocks, revision, finality and gaps. End is exclusive. Metric-specific interval and retained-publication restrictions apply. No new observation is acquired. Without an account it serves metrics whose plan is free (get_asset_metrics shows the plan of each row) at 24h, 1w, 1M or 1Y; anything else answers with the plan it needs and the free metrics closest to it.

asset.description: Asset code, for example BTC or ETH; get_assets_list gives every code with its name.

interval.description: Resolution of the observations: 24h daily, 1w weekly, 1M monthly or 1Y yearly. get_metric_metadata gives the intervals a metric offers.

metric.description: Metric id, for example ckh.SpotPrice or eth.PriceUSD; get_asset_metrics lists every id.

publication.description: An actual retained publication ID; only supported metric/interval pairs accept it.

sma.description: Smoothing window in observations; 0 returns the raw series.

smoothing.description: How sma smooths the series: simple mean (sma), exponential mean (ema) or moving median (median).
